name: Question 1
worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${f}_{13}$, we remove the $1$st row and $3$rd column:

$$
F=[\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & 5 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & 7 & ∗ & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & ∗ & 4 & -1 \\ 5 & -5 & ∗ & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & 4 & ∗ & 11 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

   

So, the minor is

$$
{M}_{13}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 7 & 0 & 3 \\ 1 & 2 & 4 & -1 \\ 5 & -5 & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & 4 & 11 & 2\end{aligned}|.
$$
